newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 13.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 45.79 points to 7,039.37, recovering from an earlier drop of more than 70 points.
* Indonesia will announce a new package of economic deregulation measures within a few months, Coordinating Minister for Production and Distribution Hartarto said on Wednesday.
* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index ended 5.33 points lower at 682.61 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,399.75/400.50 at 0135 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,398.00/9.00
* Conglomerate Bakrie on reports it planned to seek approval for a bonus issue and a raise in its authorised capital.

* Indofood on reports it had lowered the price of its planned acquisitions of several firms under the Salim Group and that cigarette tycoon Putra Sampoerna had bought a 5.63-percent stake in the firm.
* Timber firm Barito Pacific on market talk the firm was expected to announce a rights issue in the near term.
* Bank PDFCI, Bank Papan Sejahtera and Bank Ficorinvest on reports the central bank, Bank Indonesia, planned to sell its stakes in the banks.
